question: How should the practitioner meditate on the goddess who grants all prosperity?
premises: The goddess should be invoked in the middle.
She should be meditated upon as the giver of all prosperity.
inference: After invoking her in the center, one should meditate on the goddess as the bestower of all prosperity.
plain_english: Having invoked the goddess in the middle, one should meditate on her as the giver of all prosperity.
